summary: Q/C Technologies, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the termination of a Technology License and Development Agreement with LightSolver Ltd., effective June 26, 2026. The agreement had granted an exclusive license for laser processing hardware for cryptocurrency mining. The termination relieves the company from milestone payments. Separately, the company announced a strategic shift to focus on its optical processing unit (OPU) initiative for AI inference, aiming to develop silicon photonic computing. This is a routine operational update; no special situation transaction (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, tender, spin-off) is described. The filing lacks specific financial terms, stakeholder involvement, or event-driven arbitrage considerations.
